name: South Gate Pass
summary: Travelers cross South Gate Pass between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan. Its guarded road links Ironforge with Thelsamar.

sections.title: The Road East
sections.body: South Gate Pass cuts through the Khaz Modan range, joining Dun Morogh's high mountains to Loch Modan's valley in the east. Stone archways mark the way from cold slopes into warmer dwarven heartlands. The road leads toward Thelsamar, carrying mountaineers, couriers, and newly trained adventurers setting out from the capital.

sections.title: A Guarded Threshold
sections.body: Dwarven mountaineers keep watch at South Gate Outpost, guarding the pass against wild beasts and prowling troggs. The road is safer than the untamed parts of the valley, though hostile wildlife and roving threats still test its approaches. Stay on the road as you travel.

faq.q: Where does South Gate Pass lead?
aliases: where does south gate pass go
faq.answer: Take the road west through the tunnels to Dun Morogh's snowy highlands, then continue toward Ironforge. Eastward, the pass descends into Loch Modan's basin and leads toward Thelsamar.

faq.q: Is South Gate Pass safe to travel?
faq.answer: Dwarven guards at South Gate Outpost make the road relatively secure. Bears, spiders, and troggs still inhabit the crags and hillsides around the tunnel mouth.

faq.q: Why is this pass used more than North Gate Pass?
faq.answer: South Gate Pass offers the most direct and convenient overland route between Dun Morogh and Thelsamar. Local trade, supply caravans, and travelers bound for central Loch Modan favor it for that reason.

angles.text: As a dwarf leaving Dun Morogh, you pass from icy mountain air into Loch Modan's open valleys and quarries.
For the Alliance, South Gate Pass links Ironforge with the eastern Alliance territories. The King's Mountaineers maintain and secure the route.
